title: What AI startups took from Palantir's playbook: forward deployed engineers and ontologies
thesis: AI startups and labs copy Palantir's playbook (forward deployed engineers plus an ontology over existing data) because it works, and the bottleneck is people, not technology.
audience: Founders and enterprise AI leaders deciding whether to build a forward-deployed, ontology-led delivery model
